Universal quote & shipment setup.intent: Convert RFQ/order into an authorised shipment file with commercial, compliance, credit and data gates resolved.

Export air operations.intent: Move export air cargo from instructions through security, customs, airline tender, uplift and destination pre-alert.

Import air operations.intent: Move import air cargo from pre-alert through clearance, terminal release, delivery and post-entry handoff.

Export ocean FCL.intent: Move full-container export cargo from instruction through booking, equipment, VGM, gate-in, BL and departure milestones.

Import ocean FCL.intent: Move import full containers from pre-alert through clearance, carrier release, terminal availability, delivery and dehire.

Export ocean LCL / consolidation.intent: Receive, consolidate, document and depart less-than-container-load export cargo via CFS/container stuffing process.

Import ocean LCL / deconsolidation.intent: Receive consolidation pre-alert, deconsolidate, clear and deliver LCL cargo while controlling CFS storage and release status.

Customs brokerage & trade compliance.intent: Prepare, lodge, monitor, release and retain compliant customs declarations and trade records across modes.

Inland transport & last-mile.intent: Plan, dispatch, track and close domestic transport legs with proof-of-pickup, proof-of-delivery and safety controls.

Warehouse / CFS / cross-dock.intent: Receive, store, handle, pick, stage, dispatch and reconcile goods with inventory, OS&D and compliance controls.

Billing, cost control & file close.intent: Convert operational events into accurate accruals, vendor matching, invoicing, margin checks and financial closure.

Digital, automation & data quality.intent: Maintain workflow templates, event mappings, validation rules, visibility feeds and audit controls for human and digital workers.

Exceptions, claims & quality loop.intent: Detect exceptions, stabilise the shipment, communicate impacts, preserve claim evidence and feed corrective actions back into SOPs.

enterprise.label: 200+ / enterprise or shared-service network
enterprise.description: Full-detail role model. Best for large branches, regional control towers or networks with separate air, ocean, customs, finance, risk and digital teams.
enterprise.logic: No consolidation. Every baseline role appears as its own column and remains directly editable.

large.label: 50-200 / large multi-service branch
large.description: Keeps operating desks mostly separate, but consolidates support functions that are commonly shared locally or regionally.
large.logic: Operations roles remain distinct; billing/payables and risk/claims are combined for a more realistic branch view.

mid.label: 20-50 / mid-sized branch
mid.description: Good for a multi-modal SME branch where staff are specialised by desk, but support and management hats overlap.
mid.logic: Sales/CS, import/export by mode, road/warehouse, customs/trade and finance are consolidated into practical working hats.

small.label: 1-20 / compact branch
small.description: A practical small-branch lens. Useful when one or two senior people own commercial decisions, operations and escalation control.
small.logic: Roles consolidate into six hats. This is intentionally a roll-up view; use the detailed profile for exact per-role editing.

tasks.title: Margin check completed before customer invoice
tasks.trigger: Sell and buy charges are ready or materially complete.
tasks.gate: Expected vs actual margin, quote variances, unbilled accessorials and approvals for write-offs/credits reviewed.

tasks.title: Customer invoice drafted with supporting documents attached
tasks.trigger: Operational milestone triggers invoice readiness.
tasks.gate: POD, BL/AWB, customs release, delivery order, PO, tax detail and charge support attached as required.

tasks.title: Credit terms, credit hold and payment risk checked
tasks.trigger: Customer invoice or disbursement/payment required.
tasks.gate: Credit status, overdue debt, COD/collect terms, duty/tax disbursement and management override checked.

tasks.title: Invoice issued and dispute/escalation workflow active
tasks.trigger: Draft invoice approved and credit pass received.
tasks.gate: Invoice delivery method, supporting docs, customer portal requirements and dispute owner are confirmed.

tasks.title: File financial closure and missing-cost sweep completed
tasks.trigger: Shipment delivered/departed and expected invoices received/accrued.
tasks.gate: Open accruals, missing sell charges, vendor disputes, credit notes and margin variance checked before close.

tasks.title: KPI/reporting feed updated
tasks.trigger: File close or milestone event finalised.
tasks.gate: Milestone timestamps, margin, exception codes, billing lag and data completeness pushed to reporting layer.

tasks.title: SOP/workflow template selected for shipment profile
tasks.trigger: Shipment file is opened or new customer lane is onboarded.
tasks.gate: Mode, direction, service level, customer SLA, compliance gates and event triggers mapped to workflow template.

tasks.title: Milestone/event mapping maintained across carrier, customs, CFS and cartage sources
tasks.trigger: New integration, route, carrier or customer visibility need.
tasks.gate: Cargo iQ, DCSA, customs response, CMR/POD, CFS and financial events mapped to standard status vocabulary.

tasks.title: Data quality validation rules maintained
tasks.trigger: Recurring manual rekeying, customs rejects or customer status disputes identified.
tasks.gate: Mandatory fields, reference data, HS/value checks, date logic, charge codes and exception thresholds maintained.

tasks.title: Bot/digital-worker exception queue reviewed
tasks.trigger: Automation cannot complete task, API rejects message or SLA threshold breached.
tasks.gate: Exception reason, owner assignment, retry rule, data correction and customer impact reviewed.
tasks.output: Resolved automation exception or human handoff.

tasks.title: Customer visibility/status feed published
tasks.trigger: Milestone event or exception is confirmed.
tasks.gate: Event timestamp, source, ETA, exception reason, customer-specific wording and suppress/notify rules validated.

tasks.title: Master data/reference-data change control completed
tasks.trigger: New customer, carrier, location, charge code, HS table or integration mapping required.
tasks.gate: Owner, effective date, approval, testing, rollback and dependent workflows checked.

tasks.title: Audit trail and segregation-of-duties check completed
tasks.trigger: Automation touches billing, customs, payments or compliance-sensitive actions.
tasks.gate: System log, user/robot identity, approval path, edit history and override controls reviewed.

tasks.title: Automation performance and process bottlenecks reviewed
tasks.trigger: Monthly KPI review or recurring exception patterns.
tasks.gate: Straight-through processing rate, SLA misses, manual touches, data defects and root causes reviewed.

tasks.title: Exception detected by milestone, customer, vendor or system
tasks.trigger: Delay, damage, hold, cost variance, data error or missed SLA identified.
tasks.gate: Exception type, shipment impact, root trigger, customer SLA and immediate risk are captured.

tasks.title: Severity and customer impact triaged
tasks.trigger: Exception case opened.
tasks.gate: Severity, revenue/customer risk, cargo sensitivity, regulatory impact and escalation level determined.

tasks.title: Operational recovery options developed
tasks.trigger: Exception requires action to protect service or compliance outcome.
tasks.gate: Alternate routing/carrier, storage mitigation, exam scheduling, customer decision, cost impact and feasibility assessed.

tasks.title: Customer communication and revised ETA/plan issued
tasks.trigger: Recovery plan selected or material service impact known.
tasks.gate: Message is factual, timely, options/impact clear, revised ETA included and commitment owner named.

tasks.title: Carrier/vendor claim notice and evidence preservation completed
tasks.trigger: Damage, loss, shortage, delay claim or liability risk identified.
tasks.gate: POD notations, photos, seal records, temperature logs, invoices, reserve letters and claim deadlines preserved.

tasks.title: Insurance/customer claim assessment completed
tasks.trigger: Customer submits claim or insurer/carrier requests evidence.
tasks.gate: Liability basis, policy cover, claim quantum, salvage, mitigation and customer communication plan assessed.

tasks.title: Root cause and corrective action recorded
tasks.trigger: Exception or claim is resolved enough to analyse.
tasks.gate: Cause, controllability, recurrence risk, action owner, due date and effectiveness check recorded.

tasks.title: SOP, automation trigger and KPI updated
tasks.trigger: Corrective action requires process, data or customer workflow change.
tasks.gate: Workflow template, milestone triggers, RACI owner, customer SOP, training and reporting codes updated.

FAILNOTES.sales>customer_service: Verbal commitments not written into the SOP; ops discovers "included" services at invoicing.
FAILNOTES.customer_service>ocean_export: Incomplete cargo data forces re-booking; DG disclosed late kills the space.
FAILNOTES.customer_service>air_export: Incomplete cargo data forces re-booking; DG disclosed late kills the space.
FAILNOTES.ocean_export>warehouse_cfs: Warehouse receives cargo with no booking match; unverified weights flow into VGM.
FAILNOTES.air_export>warehouse_cfs: Warehouse receives cargo with no booking match; tendered weights differ from booked.
FAILNOTES.warehouse_cfs>ocean_export: SI built from booked (not verified) figures — misdeclaration risk and re-rates.
FAILNOTES.ocean_export>broker: Value/HS inconsistencies between invoice and declaration; broker files from stale versions.
FAILNOTES.air_export>broker: Value/HS inconsistencies between invoice and declaration; broker files from stale versions.
FAILNOTES.ocean_export>ocean_import: The classic one: late or partial pre-alerts on short transits — destination clears blind or late.
FAILNOTES.air_export>air_import: Late pre-alert on short-haul air — cargo lands before the file does.
FAILNOTES.ocean_import>broker: Missing importer registrations (EIN/EORI/ABN) stall entry on arrival day; PGA flags found late.
FAILNOTES.air_import>broker: Missing importer registrations stall entry on arrival day; PGA flags found late.
FAILNOTES.broker>billing: Duty payment misses customs deadline — storage accrues while cargo sits released-but-unpaid.
FAILNOTES.broker>ocean_import: Release message received but delivery order not actioned — free time burns silently.
FAILNOTES.ocean_import>road_cartage: D.O. secured but delivery slot missed — demurrage/detention accrues.
FAILNOTES.air_import>road_cartage: Airline storage accrues while delivery booking waits on a missing release code.
FAILNOTES.road_cartage>billing: POD chased for weeks; billing blocked; accessorials never make the invoice.
FAILNOTES.ocean_import>billing: Unrecorded accessorials = margin leakage; disputed invoices from surprise charges.
FAILNOTES.billing>credit: Invoice issued against an exhausted credit line — release decisions made blind.
FAILNOTES.warehouse_cfs>claims: Notice to carrier issued outside the contractual window — recourse extinguished before the claim starts.
FAILNOTES.customer_service>claims: Exception surfaced to client before evidence is secured — expectations set, then missed.
